TAX = 0.08

def price(base, discount):
    discounted = base * (1 - discount)
    return discounted + discounted * TAX

regular_price = price(60, 0.0)   # 0% discount
member_price  = price(60, 0.25)  # 25% discount
vip_price     = price(60, 0.5)   # 50% discount

print(round(regular_price, 2), round(member_price, 2), round(vip_price, 2))
